```ts
// Pinned factory signature (KI-137 imports exactly this name)
export function profileRoutes(): LocalRoute[];
```

## Outcome

In local mode the owner's Settings work without khala.aiur.team: `GET /api/local/profile` returns the local owner profile (and doubles as the browser's session check), and `POST /api/local/profile/{username,color,initials}` change it. Changing the username from `kevin` to `kev` renames every agent still on a default name in every local channel (`kevin-Claude` → `kev-Claude`, `kevin-Codex-2` → `kev-Codex-2`) and the owner's own display name, while custom agent names and listening modes are untouched. Error bodies map through the web's existing `ProfilePort` handling unchanged.

Nothing is sent to khala.aiur.team."

## Contract and invariants

Contracts **L6** (verbatim, profile lines):

> Auth: owner cookie (browser; mutations need `x-khala-local: 1`) **or** `Authorization: Bearer <adminToken>` from `helper.json` (CLI). Never an agent token.
>
> ```ts
> // GET    /api/local/profile                                   → OwnerProfileView   (also the browser's session check: 401 without the cookie)
> // POST   /api/local/profile/username  body {username}         → { username }   400 {"error":"invalid_username","reason":NameError}; renames agents still on a default name (isDefaultAgentName) in every channel, like hosted renameDefaultAgents
> // POST   /api/local/profile/color     body {color}            → { color }      400 {"error":"invalid_color"}
> // POST   /api/local/profile/initials  body {initials|null}    → { initials }   follows the hosted initials contract once PR #986 merges; until then 1–2 letters [A-Za-z] or null
> ```

Contracts **L7** (verbatim):

> ```ts
> export type OwnerProfile = { v: 1; username: string; color: HumanColorId; initials?: string; updatedAt: string };   // <stateRoot>/local/owner.json
> export type OwnerProfileView = { userId: typeof LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID; ownerId: typeof LOCAL_OWNER_ID; username: string; suggestion: string; color: HumanColorId; initials?: string };
> // The web's ProfilePort.get() maps it to ProfileView {username, suggestion, color} (`packages/contracts/src/m1/profile.ts:7`); username is never null locally, so the first-run username gate never shows.
> ```
>
> - `username` obeys `checkName(name,'username')` (`packages/contracts/src/m1/names.ts:18-26`). `initials` (when present) obeys the same rule as the hosted initials work in flight (PR #986); until that merges, 1–2 letters `[A-Za-z]`.
> - Local identity is never fetched from or written to khala.aiur.team (D8).

Contracts **L3** replay rules used (verbatim): "Display names come only from member events. A rename is a new member event with the same membership and a new `displayname`, sent by the owner." and "Listening mode of an agent = `content['com.khala.listening_mode']` of its last member event, else `sync`".

PR #986 initials rule (verbatim from its new contracts module `@khala/contracts/m1/initials`, head `185cfeb3`):

```ts
export function normalizeInitials(input: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof input !== 'string') return null;
  const nfc = input.normalize('NFC');
  if ([...nfc].length !== 2) return null;
  const up = nfc.toLocaleUpperCase('en-US');
  return /^[\p{L}\p{Nd}]{2}$/u.test(up) ? up : null;
}
```

**Initials decision (pinned here, reported to the planner as an L6/L7 text fix):** local initials follow the PR #986 rule now (exactly two letters or digits, NFC, upper-cased; `null` clears), not the interim "1–2 letters". If `@khala/contracts/m1/initials` exists on `origin/main` at pickup, import `normalizeInitials` from it; otherwise copy the function above verbatim as a module-private function with the comment `// Copy of PR #986 normalizeInitials; replace with the import once it merges.` Behaviour is identical either way.

Invariants:
1. **Owner gate** on all four routes: `auth.kind === 'none'` → `401 {"error":"unauthorized"}`; `auth.kind === 'agent'` → `403 {"error":"forbidden"}`; cookie and admin owners are both allowed.
2. Success bodies have exactly one key (`username`, `color`, `initials`) — the web rejects extra keys.
3. `suggestion` = the current username (always valid, so the web's username gate never shows).
4. `initials` is omitted from `OwnerProfileView` when unset (L7 `initials?: string`) and the stored `OwnerProfile` never contains `initials: null` (clearing deletes the key).
5. `updatedAt` = `new Date(ctx.now()).toISOString()` on every change; an unchanged value writes nothing.
6. The cascade only renames agents whose current name `isDefaultAgentName(name, previousUsername, harness)`; it keeps the numeric suffix, preserves `membership`, `harness` and `com.khala.listening_mode`, never produces a name that collides (case-insensitive) with another present member of the same channel, and one failing channel/agent never stops the rest or the 200.
7. The owner's own member event in every channel where the owner is present gets the new `displayname` (display names come only from member events).
8. Everything runs inside one per-factory serial queue (`serial()` as in KI-132) so two username changes never interleave cascades.

### Worked example

Owner `{ v:1, username:'kevin', color:'blue', updatedAt:'2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' }`. Channel A members: owner `kevin`, `@agent-a1b2c3d4:local` `kevin-Claude` (mode `steer`), `@agent-b2c3d4e5:local` `kevin-Codex-2`, `@agent-c3d4e5f6:local` `reviewer` (claude). Channel B members: owner `kevin`, `@agent-d4e5f6a7:local` `kevin-Claude`, `@agent-e5f6a7b8:local` `kev-Claude` (codex; a custom name).

```
GET /api/local/profile    (cookie)
← 200 {"userId":"@khala_owner:local","ownerId":"local-owner","username":"kevin","suggestion":"kevin","color":"blue"}

POST /api/local/profile/username {"username":"kev"}
  store.setOwner({v:1, username:"kev", color:"blue", updatedAt:"2026-10-02T09:00:00.000Z"})
  channel A appends (sender @khala_owner:local, m.room.member):
    {"user":"@khala_owner:local","membership":"join","displayname":"kev","kind":"human"}
    {"user":"@agent-a1b2c3d4:local","membership":"join","displayname":"kev-Claude","kind":"agent","harness":"claude","com.khala.listening_mode":"steer"}
    {"user":"@agent-b2c3d4e5:local","membership":"join","displayname":"kev-Codex-2","kind":"agent","harness":"codex","com.khala.listening_mode":"sync"}
    (reviewer unchanged)
  channel B appends:
    owner → "kev"
    @agent-d4e5f6a7:local → "kev-Claude-2"      ("kev-Claude" is taken by the custom-named codex agent)
← 200 {"username":"kev"}

POST /api/local/profile/username {"username":"kevin-Claude"}  ← 400 {"error":"invalid_username","reason":"reserved"}
POST /api/local/profile/color {"color":"teal"}                ← 200 {"color":"teal"}
POST /api/local/profile/color {"color":"mauve"}               ← 400 {"error":"invalid_color"}
POST /api/local/profile/initials {"initials":"kw"}            ← 200 {"initials":"KW"}
POST /api/local/profile/initials {"initials":null}            ← 200 {"initials":null}     (owner.json loses the initials key)
POST /api/local/profile/initials {"initials":"K"}             ← 400 {"error":"invalid_initials"}
```

### Steps

1. **Imports.**
   ```ts
   import { isHumanColorId } from '@khala/contracts/m1/colors';
   import { DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE, LISTENING_MODE_MEMBER_KEY } from '@khala/contracts/m1/listening-mode';
   import { LOCAL_OWNER_ID, LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID, type OwnerProfile } from '@khala/contracts/m1/local';
   import { checkName, defaultAgentName, isDefaultAgentName } from '@khala/contracts/m1/names';
   import { decodeWith, object } from '@khala/contracts/messaging/decode';
   import type { HelperContext, LocalRequest, LocalResponse, LocalRoute } from '../types';
   ```
2. **Helpers:** `fail(status, code)`, `serial()`, `gate(req)` (invariant 1), `field(body, key)` = `decodeWith(() => object(body, '', [key]).field(key))` (exact single key; `!ok` → `400 invalid_request`, as `apps/control/src/profile/routes.ts:113-114`), `normalizeInitials` (import or private copy, see above), `iso(ctx)`.
3. Patterns (regex literals): `GET /^\/api\/local\/profile$/u`, `POST /^\/api\/local\/profile\/username$/u`, `POST /^\/api\/local\/profile\/color$/u`, `POST /^\/api\/local\/profile\/initials$/u`.
4. **`get`**: `p = store.owner()` → `200 { userId: LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID, ownerId: LOCAL_OWNER_ID, username: p.username, suggestion: p.username, color: p.color, ...(p.initials ? { initials: p.initials } : {}) }`.
5. **`setUsername`**: `v = field(body, 'username')`; `checked = checkName(v.value, 'username')`; `!ok` → `400 { error: 'invalid_username', reason: checked.error }`. In the queue: `p = store.owner()`; `if (p.username === checked.name) return 200 { username }`; `await store.setOwner({ ...p, username: checked.name, updatedAt: iso(ctx) })`; `try { await cascade(store, p.username, checked.name) } catch { /* best effort, as hosted production.ts */ }`; `200 { username: checked.name }`.
6. **`cascade(store, previous, next)`**: for each `{ roomId }` of `store.listChannels()` inside its own `try/catch`:
   - `members = store.members(roomId)`; `taken = new Set(members.map(m => m.displayName.toLowerCase()))`.
   - Owner: `o = members.find(m => m.userId === LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID)`; if `o && o.displayName !== next`: append `m.room.member` sender owner `{ user: LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID, membership: o.membership, displayname: next, kind: 'human' }`; `taken.delete(o.displayName.toLowerCase()); taken.add(next.toLowerCase())`.
   - Agents (in `members` order), each inside `try/catch`: skip unless `m.kind === 'agent' && m.harness && isDefaultAgentName(m.displayName, previous, m.harness)`. `n = Number(/-(\d+)$/u.exec(m.displayName)?.[1] ?? 1)` (skip when not a safe integer ≥ 1 — copy of `rename.ts:197-200`; note `kevin-Claude` has no numeric tail so `n = 1`). `taken.delete(m.displayName.toLowerCase())`. `name = defaultAgentName(next, m.harness, n)`; if `taken.has(name.toLowerCase())`, `name` = `defaultAgentName(next, m.harness, k)` for the smallest `k ≥ 1` not in `taken`. If `!checkName(name, 'agent').ok` → `taken.add(m.displayName.toLowerCase())` and skip. If `name !== m.displayName` append `m.room.member` sender owner `{ user: m.userId, membership: m.membership, displayname: name, kind: 'agent', harness: m.harness, [LISTENING_MODE_MEMBER_KEY]: m.listeningMode ?? DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE }`. `taken.add(name.toLowerCase())`.
7. **`setColor`**: `v = field(body, 'color')`; `!isHumanColorId(v.value)` → `400 { error: 'invalid_color' }`. In the queue: if different, `setOwner({ ...p, color, updatedAt })`. `200 { color }`.
8. **`setInitials`**: `v = field(body, 'initials')`; `initials = v.value === null ? null : normalizeInitials(v.value)`; `v.value !== null && initials === null` → `400 { error: 'invalid_initials' }`. In the queue: `p = store.owner()`; if `(p.initials ?? null) !== initials`: `const { initials: _old, ...rest } = p; await store.setOwner(initials === null ? { ...rest, updatedAt } : { ...rest, initials, updatedAt })`. `200 { initials }`.
9. Wrap each handler in `try { … } catch { return fail(503, 'unavailable'); }`.

## Test scenarios

File: `packages/agent/src/local/routes/profile.test.ts` (vitest). Do not import `../store` or `../http`.

Fake store (in the test file, cast `as unknown as LocalStore`; other methods throw `'not used'`): `owner()`/`setOwner(next)` over a variable (record every `setOwner` arg); `listChannels()` → `[{ roomId }]` for each seeded channel; `members(roomId)` derived by replaying that channel's member events (last per user, present = invite|join, `listeningMode` default `sync`, as in the KI-133 test fake); `append(roomId, input)` pushes an event (optionally configured to throw for one user id). A `call()` helper as in KI-132. `ctx.now = () => Date.parse('2026-10-02T09:00:00.000Z')`.

1. **Gate.** All four routes: `{kind:'none'}` → `401 {"error":"unauthorized"}`; agent auth → `403 {"error":"forbidden"}`; `{kind:'owner', via:'admin'}` → allowed.
2. **GET.** Exactly the keys `userId, ownerId, username, suggestion, color` (no `initials` key when unset); with `initials: 'KW'` stored, the key is present.
3. **Username validation.** `'a'` → `reason 'too_short'`; `'x'.repeat(25)` → `'too_long'`; `'bad name'` → `'invalid_characters'`; `'kevin-Claude'` → `'reserved'`; `'owner'` → `'reserved'`; `42` → `400 invalid_username, reason 'invalid_characters'`. Body `{}`, `{ username: 'kev', x: 1 }`, `null` → `400 { error: 'invalid_request' }`. Nothing appended, `setOwner` not called.
4. **Cascade (worked example).** After `POST username kev` the appended events equal the worked example exactly, in order; `reviewer` and the custom `kev-Claude` get no event; `setOwner` received `{ v:1, username:'kev', color:'blue', updatedAt:'2026-10-02T09:00:00.000Z' }`; response `200 { username: 'kev' }`. Mutation check: replace `isDefaultAgentName(m.displayName, previous, …)` with `next` and the test fails.
5. **Suffix kept.** `kevin-Codex-2` → `kev-Codex-2` (not `kev-Codex`).
6. **Case-only change.** `kevin` → `Kevin`: `kevin-Claude` becomes `Kevin-Claude`; owner display name `Kevin`.
7. **No-op.** Same username → `200`, no `setOwner`, no appends.
8. **Isolation.** `append` throws for `@agent-a1b2c3d4:local` → still `200`; the other agents are renamed.
9. **Mode preserved.** The renamed `kevin-Claude` (mode `steer`) keeps `com.khala.listening_mode: 'steer'`.
10. **Colour.** `teal` → `200 { color: 'teal' }` and stored; `mauve` → `400 { error: 'invalid_color' }`; `{}` → `400 invalid_request`; same colour again → `200`, no `setOwner`.
11. **Initials.** `'kw'` → `{ initials: 'KW' }`; `'é1'` → `{ initials: 'É1' }`; `'K'`, `'abc'`, `'k!'`, `7` → `400 { error: 'invalid_initials' }`; `null` → `200 { initials: null }` and the stored profile has **no** `initials` key (`'initials' in stored === false`). Response bodies always have exactly one key.
12. **Web compatibility.** For each success body, `Object.keys(body)` equals exactly `['username']`, `['color']` or `['initials']`; each 400 body has `error` and, for usernames, a `reason` in `['too_short','too_long','invalid_characters','reserved']`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `profileRoutes(): LocalRoute[]` exports the 4 routes with regex-literal patterns.
- [ ] Owner gate; GET returns `OwnerProfileView` with `suggestion = username`.
- [ ] Username validation and error bodies as hosted; cascade renames default-named agents (suffix kept, collisions avoided, modes preserved) and the owner's display name in every channel; best effort per agent.
- [ ] Colour and initials (PR #986 rule) validated, persisted via `setOwner`, single-key bodies.
- [ ] No import of `../store`, `../http`, `apps/*`; no network; no new dependency.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **S1 Stop** if KI-110's `OwnerProfile`/`OwnerProfileView`/`LocalStore.owner()/setOwner()` differ from the L7/L8 quotes.
- **S2** PR #986 (custom initials) may merge before pickup and change the hosted rule or response shape; re-read `@khala/contracts/m1/initials` and `apps/control/src/profile/routes.ts` at pickup and mirror whatever merged. If it merged with a rule different from the quote above, follow the merged code and report.
- **S3** If the planner changes `OwnerProfileView.initials` to `string | null` (recommended to match #986's `ProfileView`), return `initials: null` when unset instead of omitting the key; otherwise follow invariant 4.
- **S4** PR #978 (per-human colours) may add colour behaviour to the web; the local route only stores the chosen `HumanColorId`. Refresh `packages/contracts/src/m1/colors.ts` at pickup.
- Scope caps: never call khala.aiur.team, never read or write `hosted-profile.json` (that is KI-122), no uniqueness reservation.

## Complexity rationale

1: four small handlers over `store.owner()/setOwner()` plus one bounded cascade loop with a collision set; validators all exist in `@khala/contracts`.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
